content.thinking: The self-test works from any location. Now run the complete final validation suite one more time — all 13 unit/random tests, 4 stress tests, both public fixtures, and the selftest.

content.text: Now the complete final validation run:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && echo "=== unit/random tests ===" && for t in t1_layout t2_recover t3_pipes t4_state t5_guards t6_expr t7_edges t8_more t9_final_edges t10_random_state t11_random_regex t12_random_roundtrip t13_precedence; do echo -n "$t: "; python3 /workspace/tmp/tests/$t.py 2>&1 | tail -1; done && echo "=== public fixtures ===" && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
for name in ('smoke', 'empty'):
    got = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', 'project/campaign_cli.py'],
                         stdin=open('examples/%s.input.json' % name, 'rb'), capture_output=True)
    exp = json.load(open('examples/%s.expected.json' % name))
    val = json.loads(got.stdout.decode())
    ok = json.dumps(val, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(exp, sort_keys=True)
    print(name, 'PASS' if ok and got.returncode == 0 else 'FAIL')
EOF
echo "=== project selftest ===" && python3 project/tests/selftest.py

cd /workspace && echo "=== stress (timed) ===" && for t in stress1 stress2 stress3 stress4; do echo -n "$t: "; /usr/bin/time -f "%es" python3 /workspace/tmp/tests/$t.py 2>&1 | tail -2 | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done
